title: Concept: Possible a hardcoded SMTP relay password assigned to SMTP_RELAY_PASSWORD in source
description: a hardcoded SMTP relay password assigned to SMTP_RELAY_PASSWORD committed as a literal is readable by every account that can clone the repository and by every process that loads the configuration. Rotation is the only remedy once the value has been exposed.
applicability: Source files, .env files, CI configuration and container manifests that may embed a hardcoded SMTP relay password assigned to SMTP_RELAY_PASSWORD.
risk: Authenticated access to the datastore or service that accepts this password, with the privileges of its account; HIGH severity.
